review_type: Independent applicability audit; no calibration applied and no research input changed

figure18_processing_at_review.display_at_initial_inspection: raw amplitude divided by initial three living-cell readings; raw mV endpoint bars
figure18_processing_at_review.subsequent_display_instruction: Root authorized each acquisition stage normalized to its own first value; this is a display normalization, not gain/background/cross-talk calibration; raw endpoint bars remain unchanged.

system_verification_methods.signal: Use same-acquisition-set illuminated DDW blank in complex I/Q, then independent calibration phase projection; retain signed response.
system_verification_methods.concentration: Set A linear and set B exponential per-channel fluorescein calibration after blank subtraction and phase projection. Those inverse functions are not cellular GCaMP calibrations.
system_verification_methods.matrix: Measured isolated-source complex matrix was evaluated, but failed simultaneous-loading additivity and reliable transfer.
system_verification_methods.matrix_conclusion: Do not apply the isolated-well proportions or those percentages as correction factors to living-cell test3. A constant per-channel multiplier would cancel in within-channel F/Fstart ratios anyway.

saved_blank_inspection.biological_contents: Not independently specified by the user condition map; context Medium is a saved UI label.
saved_blank_inspection.failure_mode: A nonnegative |z-B| measures distance from the blank. For D3 it becomes about50.05mV when raw amplitude falls to26.46mV; it cannot be interpreted as positive fluorescence recovery.

dilution_hypothesis.restriction: The following is a hypothetical conserved soluble concentration model, not a correction for cell-associated reporter fluorescence or raw electrical amplitude.
dilution_hypothesis.formula: If signal were proportional to conserved soluble concentration, post/pre=Vinitial/(Vinitial+Vadded); Vadded/Vinitial=1/(post/pre)-1.
dilution_hypothesis.interpretation: D1 and D4 increase, whereas D2 and D3 decrease by different fractions. A shared dilution-only factor cannot explain all four raw changes. Dilution or handling may contribute, but the data do not isolate it.
dilution_hypothesis.hundredfold_dilution_note: A stated100xVUAA1 preparation does not determine how much was added to the wells. Only if one volume of stock were added to99volumes of sample would a conserved soluble sample component dilute by1%; that recipe is not assumed here.
dilution_hypothesis.cellular_caution: The reporter is cell-associated; adding medium does not by itself establish proportional dilution of total reporter signal. Actual volumes, cell retention, mixing and a vehicle-addition control are needed.

permitted_interpretation: Retain raw voltage and stage-normalized trajectories as descriptive electrical readouts. Independent net fluorescence requires verified matched background and an appropriate phase reference; reliable well-source unmixing needs a validated cellular/loading-specific transfer. Do not tune coefficients to make wet-lab and hardware agree.
